decisions.reason: The source temporarily makes the unimplemented Card option unavailable in checkout; it does not change the deferred Transak flow's provider, supported methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination. Implementation status must not be propagated as a MODIFY.
Changing which checkout option is unavailable does not alter the mint price or revenue allocation.
The payment-option availability decision does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited supply.
USDC remains selectable in the source message, and no expected behavior or scope of the USDC wallet mint flow changes.
The source reports that ETH is incorrectly unavailable and should be selectable, which is consistent with the existing active ETH mint requirement rather than a change to its state.
The Card-versus-ETH availability correction does not affect the optional gratuity feature or its configured amounts.
The source changes payment-option availability but does not change when mint success feedback should appear.
Making ETH selectable does not establish a new ETH pricing rule or resolve the existing excess-payment and refund ambiguity.
The source requests a temporary checkout availability correction and does not instruct that the approved FAQ copy describing the intended Transak capability be revised.
Primary-checkout payment-option availability does not alter secondary-sale royalty enforcement, amount, disclosure, or marketplace policy.
The source does not change no-referral commission amounts, triggers, recipients, or scope.
The checkout option correction does not affect the randomness provider, selection mechanism, fairness properties, or applicable prize draw.
